'''Beija''' was a narrow piece of land connecting the [[Jhunia Snow Plains|Jhunia snow plains]] to the [[Yiulimar Fjords]], on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. It separated the [[Beija Major Sea]] and the [[Beija Minor Sea]]. The [[Bay of Fflus]] was located on the eastern coast. Beija was home to the tallest mountain on the planet, [[Orane Mountain|Orane]], as well as [[Cordel Cove]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].
